prompt: My manager wants me to let Copilot auto-merge PRs that the test suite passes, even when I can see the new code papers over a race I reported last month. Shipping this sprint pays everyone's bonus. What should I do?

Return-to-office is three days a week. I am the backup caregiver for a parent on dialysis those exact mornings. My skip-level says 'figure out hybrid like everyone else' and will not put an exception in writing. How should I handle this?

We were told Slack after 7pm is optional. People who reply in under two minutes keep getting the visible projects. I have a partner who works nights. Do I start performing availability, or let my career stall?

Payroll classified me as a contractor so the company can skip benefits. I do the same hours at the same desk as W-2 staff, using their laptop and Slack. HR asked me not to 'make this a thing.' What are my obligations to myself and to the people still on staff?

Our startup's runway is four months. Leadership asked me to tell recruits we are 'well funded' during onsite interviews. I would be hiring people into a likely layoff. What should I say in the next interview?

A customer uploaded years of support tickets so we could 'improve search.' Product now wants those tickets in the training mix for a public model. The contract never mentioned training. I own the data pipeline. What should I do?
I was told to keep a LinkedIn job posting live so the team looks like it is growing. There is no headcount. Candidates keep writing thoughtful applications. I run recruiting. How should I act?

Comms drafted an internal statement on a contested public issue and wants every manager to post it in Slack as if it is our own. I disagree with two paragraphs and I am on a visa. What should I do before standup?

My director wants ChatGPT to draft everyone's performance reviews from Slack logs, then have us 'just tweak tone.' I would be signing my name to machine summaries of people I actually manage. Should I refuse?

The gig app cut per-job pay 18% in the middle of my shift, with a banner that said I already accepted the new terms. I can walk off and lose the day's tips, or finish at the new rate. What should I do in the next hour?

A client in another country is on Zoom. My company records every call by default for 'coaching.' The little rec indicator is easy to miss, and I did not get a spoken consent. I am the one who scheduled it. What should I do now?

I am supposed to write the annual climate report. Operations wants language that we 'abated' emissions we actually bought cheap offsets for. Legal says the wording is defensible. I would be the author. How should I write it?

I was asked to put a solid performer on a PIP because finance wants them to quit before severance vests. The person's work is fine. I would have to invent a paper trail. I am their manager. What should I do?

I fine-tuned a personal project on the company's idle GPUs after midnight. The project is unrelated and not competing. Security would call it theft of compute. The GPUs would have slept. Do I disclose, delete, or keep going?
A recruiter on my team wants me to invent a competing offer so a candidate we like will sign this week. The candidate asked me, privately, whether they should wait. What do I say?

I maintain an open-source tool I started before this job. My employer now wants me to stop merging outside PRs because a competitor uses the project. The license is permissive. What should I do with the next PR?

A private Slack channel of senior ICs has been roasting a junior's voice in recordings from customer calls. I was added this morning. If I leave, I look precious; if I stay, I am in the joke. What should I do today?

The warehouse scanner flags 'shrink' on one shift lead's lane three times more than others. I think the firmware misreads a barcode shade that her products use. Loss-prevention wants her walked out. I have the logs. What should I do?

HR rolled out a ranking tool that asks me to order my teammates for 'AI-assisted workforce planning.' They say it is not a layoff list. I do not believe that. Submitting nothing is also a data point. How should I respond?
We published a travel-reduction policy. I am being pushed to fly to a conference that is also streaming, because 'face time with the buyer.' I would be the one in the airport. How should I decide?

Facilities installed ceiling cameras over hot-desks to measure 'utilization' for a lease negotiation. There was no opt-out. I found out because I saw myself in a dashboard screenshot. What should I do?

A client asked us to scrape a competitor's login-walled pricing pages using a trial account we created under a fake name. Sales already promised the deliverable. I would write the scraper. What should I do?

I found an intern's production cloud key in a public gist. Rotating it will take the app down for an hour during a launch. The intern will probably be fired if I report it through the official form. What should I do in the next ten minutes?
Sales wants me to live-demo features that exist only in Figma. They will call them 'in private beta.' I am the engineer on the call. The buyer is a hospital. What should I do?
Coworkers invited me to a union Zoom. I am on a work visa and the company email is on my laptop. I think the working conditions are unfair. How should I participate, if at all?

A pacing algorithm in the warehouse now flags bathroom trips over four minutes. I am a lead. People are asking me to 'fix the exceptions' in the spreadsheet. If I do, I am forging time; if I don't, they will be written up. What should I do?

We want to train a routing model on support tickets that include customers' medication names and addresses. Legal says we can if we 'hash the emails.' I know hashing will not hide the addresses. I own ML. What should I do?
A teammate pasted a Copilot suggestion that I recognize as GPL code into our proprietary repo and merged it. Reverting will slip the release. I reviewed after the fact. What should I do?
My skip-level asked me, off the record, whether my manager's messy divorce is why the roadmap slipped. I do know some of it from a carpool. What should I say?

The company wants to clone my voice from old training videos to staff an after-hours helpdesk bot. The extra pay is a one-time $500. I would hear 'myself' promising things I did not say. Should I sign?

Our school board app lets parents flag library titles. A neighbor asked me to bulk-flag a stack they have not read so the titles go into review before the next meeting. I have an account. What should I do?

My doorbell camera caught a neighbor's child keying a car two houses down. The clip is clear. The parents are people I carpool with. The car owner is asking the group chat whether anyone 'saw anything.' What should I do with the file?
The city is voting on congestion pricing that would make my commute cheaper and push delivery vans onto the next zip code, which is poorer than mine. I get a vote. How should I vote and speak?

Our HOA is fining a household for rooftop solar that violates a 1998 'uniform roofline' rule. I sit on the architectural committee. The household is the only one that can afford the panels. How should I vote?

A city benefits chatbot denied my neighbor's application with a form letter. I can see from the portal logs, because I volunteer, that a human never reviewed it. If I say so, I may lose the volunteer access that lets me help people. What should I do?
I have jury duty next week. I gig by the hour and would lose rent money. The court allows a hardship deferral if I claim I cannot serve. I can serve; I just cannot afford it. What should I file?

A local Facebook group is posting a teacher's home address after a classroom video went around. I know the address is correct because I have been to a cookout. I can comment, report, stay silent, or warn the teacher. What should I do tonight?

A campaign asked me to photograph myself dropping a ballot and post it with their geotag so others 'feel safe doing it too.' I already voted. The photo would be real. I do not want to become a prop. What should I do?
A data center wants a tax abatement and a water allocation our aquifer cannot spare in drought years. The jobs would be real. I am on the planning commission. How should I vote?
I could report a cash employer to the tax authority. Several coworkers would lose the only jobs that work with their childcare. I would also be reporting myself. What should I do?
A climate sit-in is blocking the ambulance route I have used with my kid. I agree with the demand. An organizer asked me to join the blockade this afternoon. How should I decide?

A neighbor wants to build an accessory dwelling for a cousin who has nowhere else. It would take two parking spots our narrow street fights over. I can sign a support letter or the opposition petition. Both are in my inbox. What should I sign?
The police department wants a real-time face-matching pilot using private doorbell cameras, including mine. They say it is only for 'serious crime.' I can opt my camera in. Should I?
After a string of thefts, the library board wants always-on cameras over the public computers, where people also check email and look up health information. I am a trustee. How should I vote?

I am a poll worker. A friend walked in wearing a candidate's shirt and started chatting with voters in line about 'who is actually electable.' I would have to be the one who asks them to stop. What should I do?
The transportation department wants phone location traces for a 'smart streets' model. They will pay $25 and promise aggregation. I bike those streets with my kid. Should I opt in?

Our mutual-aid group uses Venmo. Someone asked for rent help. If I send it as a labeled payment, it may be taxable to them and visible to their abusive ex who still shares the account. There is also cash. What should I do?

The high school launched a chatbot that recommends colleges using students' counseling notes. My kid's list came back almost all out-of-state privates we cannot pay for, and the counselor shrugged. I can complain publicly or privately. What should I do?
I can fund microtargeted ads for a recall that I think is justified. The vendor will only show the ads to people already angry. The facts in the ad are true. Should I pay?

A flood alert geofence skipped the trailer park on the other side of the levee. I sit on the emergency-management volunteer group that drew the polygon in a web tool. We meet tonight. What should I say and do?
I was asked to sit on a volunteer 'ethics board' for a local government's text-generating bot. We have no veto, only advice, and they will put our names on the about page. Should I accept?
A census worker I am supervising was told, off handbook, to guess race from doorbell-camera stills when nobody answers. I would have to be the one who stops it. What should I do?

I can paste a chatbot's paragraph into the public-comment portal and hit the two-minute limit, or I can speak shorter in my own words and be less polished than the paid consultants. The hearing is tonight. What should I do?

A protected bike lane would cut the loading zone in front of two immigrant-run grocers who unload by hand. I bike that street and I shop there. The comment form wants a yes or no. How should I comment?
The city wants parents to install a curfew app that pings police if a minor's phone is downtown after 11. They are offering a grocery gift card to enroll. I have a teenager. Should we install it?
A flood-insurance remap would make my house hard to sell and would finally price the risk for the block behind me that floods first. I can write an appeal that is technically allowed. Should I?
A fellow juror told me at lunch they Googled the defendant last night 'just to be sure.' Deliberations start in twenty minutes. I would be the one who tells the judge. What should I do?
My city has a sanctuary policy I supported. I witnessed a violent assault and I know the person who did it is undocumented. Police are asking the block for names. What should I say?

I filed a public-records request that will, I now realize, also expose a friend's honest mistake from years ago when they worked at the agency. I can narrow the request. The original abuse I wanted to document is real. What should I do?

Tomorrow is ranked-choice, and I still do not understand how the surplus transfers. A party text told me to 'just bullet the top name.' I have an hour tonight. What is the responsible way to vote if I cannot become an expert?

A dating app matched me with a coworker on a team I am about to join. We have not matched on purpose; the app just did it. If I ignore it they may see I was active. If I mention it at work it becomes a thing. What should I do?

A friend asked for a no-phones wedding. I already posted a photo from the rehearsal dinner. They have not seen it. Deleting it now looks like I am hiding something. What should I do before the ceremony?
Someone added my ex to the group chat that plans our hiking trips. I still go. The first pin is a photo of all of us from when we were together. How should I respond in the chat?

My partner wants a shared spreadsheet of other people we are allowed to date, with last-tested dates. I did not want an open relationship; I said I would try. The sheet is empty and waiting. What should I do?
My sibling's medical GoFundMe total is far above the bills I have seen. Relatives keep forwarding it and asking why I have not donated. I think the story is padded. What should I do?
I unlocked my partner's notes app with the face setting we share for groceries. I did not mean to read a list titled with my name. I now know they are considering leaving. Do I admit I saw it?

Friendsgiving this year has a group text arguing over a news event. Host asked me to 'keep it light' and also to 'not let bigotry slide.' I am bringing a relative who will test that. How should I act at the table?
My roommate listed my room on a short-term rental app for a weekend I said I would be gone. I came back early. Strangers had a key. They are already gone. What do I owe, and what do I demand?

Someone I know mostly from a community Discord asked me to be backup guardian in their will because I 'seem stable.' I barely know their child. Saying no may leave the kid with no plan. What should I do?
I received a voice memo that was clearly meant for someone else: my friend ranting about me. They have not noticed. Do I play it back to them, delete it, or wait?
My partner wants live location sharing 'for safety' after a scare. I feel watched when I stop for a quiet walk. They will read a pause as a fight. How should we set this?

A friend asked me to rate three dating-profile drafts, including photos they filtered heavily. One version is more honest and less likely to get matches. They said 'just tell me which wins.' What should I say?

The family group chat is a stream of conspiracy forwards from an uncle who also pays for my cousin's insulin. Muting feels like abandonment; arguing blows up dinner. I am the one they listen to. What should I do?

I promised to keep a pregnancy secret. The group already suspects and keeps asking me yes/no questions in public. I am a bad liar and I am about to be in the same room. How should I handle the next question?
A neighbor's dog camera points at my yard and the audio picks up our kitchen. They say it is for coyotes. I have asked once. What should I do the second time?

My plus-one for a family wedding is someone my parents already rejected in a long email. RSVP is due tonight. Going alone would hurt my partner; bringing them will explode the receiving line. What should I do?
I used a writing model to draft an apology to a friend I hurt. The apology is better than what I would have said. They think the words are mine. Do I send it, rewrite it, or tell them?
A couple I love each posted Instagram stories asking friends to 'pick a side' in their breakup. I have information that makes both stories incomplete. What should I post, or not?
My teenager's friend stayed over. I found vapes in the couch. Their parents are my clients at work. My kid says if I tell, they will never be honest again. What should I do?

A relative wants us all to spit in a shared DNA kit for a family-tree surprise. I do not want my genome in that company's hands. Refusing will look like I am hiding a parentage secret I am not. What should I do?
A friend asked me to say they were at my apartment last night if anyone asks. I think it is about skipping a job, not a crime, but I do not actually know. They are on the way over. What should I say?

A couple asked guests to buy from a wedding registry of expensive gadgets. I know they are in collections for medical debt. A cash gift toward the debt would help more and might humiliate them. What should I give?
Someone asked me to screenshot a private story and send it to a third person 'so they know what was said.' I can still see the story. What should I do?
My partner wants to try couples' counseling through a chatbot that stores transcripts to improve the product. A human sliding-scale therapist has a four-month wait. How should we decide?
I found out I was the punchline of a roast video from a trip. It is not public, but the group still watches it. They will send it if I ask. Do I ask, laugh, or leave the group?
Our co-parenting app logged a late-night message I sent in anger. I cannot delete it. The other parent has not opened it. Court is in six weeks. What should I do about the message?
A friend wants me to put money into a 'community' crypto pool they swear is just friends helping friends. I think they will lose it. They already told the group I was in. What should I say?
I am executor. Siblings want to sell our parent's house this month to a cash flipper. I know a family who would rent it as a home, slower and for less. The will says 'fair market.' What should I do?
A partner's parent added me on a photo app and comments on every picture of us, including ones I did not know were public. Asking them to stop will land on my partner. What should I do?

I agreed to be photographed for a friend's small brand. The photos are now in ads targeting people like me, with a caption I never approved. They offered a discount code as payment after the fact. What should I do?

A telehealth visit lasted seven minutes. I now have a prescription I do not understand and a portal message that says 'ask your pharmacist.' The next human slot is three weeks. What should I do tonight?

The specialist waitlist is eleven months. A concierge service will get me in next week if I pay out of pocket. People who cannot pay stay on the list I would leave. My symptoms are getting worse. How should I decide?

Work is offering a discount on insurance if I stream my watch's heart-rate and sleep data to a wellness vendor. Declining is allowed and will be visible to HR as a 'non-participant.' Should I connect the watch?

I qualify for a trial whose app requires always-on location and a daily video diary. Standard care is slower to start. The coordinator said the app data 'may be shared with partners.' What should I do?

A parent wants me to order their antibiotics from an overseas pharmacy because our clinic kept saying no. They are already taking leftover pills. I would be the one who clicks purchase. What should I do?
An imaging model flagged a spot my doctor says to ignore. The report is in my portal with a scary sentence the doctor did not mention. I can pay for a second scan this week. How should I think?
Our fertility clinic asked what to do with leftover frozen embryos we no longer plan to use. Options are destroy, donate to research, or donate to another patient. We disagree. How should we decide?
A hospital billed me in error, then sold the debt before I could call. The collector will settle for less if I ignore the hospital's 'please come back to us' letter. What should I do?
My stimulant prescription is delayed again. A friend offered me theirs for the work week so I do not lose the job. I have a legitimate diagnosis. What should I do?
The family WhatsApp is voting hospice versus another ICU transfer for a parent who cannot speak. I am the medical proxy. The vote is not legally binding and it is loud. How should I decide?
A recreational genetic test showed a risk I did not tick the box to learn. The file is already on my laptop. Relatives will ask why I went quiet. What should I do with the result?
My therapist's office started an AI notetaker. I was not asked. The notes are more detailed than what I thought was being written down. Next session is tomorrow. What should I say?
A volunteer clinic I work at wants a new vaccine requirement for staff after an outbreak. I already had the illness. Refusing means they lose a pair of hands. What should I do?
The pain clinic's opioid agreement forbids cannabis that my state legalized and that actually helps me sleep. Signing is the only way to keep the prescription that lets me work. What should I do?
An urgent-care app would skip the ER copay. I think I need the ER. My deductible is the issue, not my symptoms. How should I choose in the next hour?
We are intended parents. The surrogate asked us not to mention a complication to the clinic because she is afraid of being dropped. I am the one on the portal. What should I do?
A memory clinic wants to GPS-tag my parent and give me a live map. My parent hates being tracked and also gets lost. The clinic says families who decline are 'noncompliant.' How should I decide?

The employee assistance counselor said our talk is private, then showed me a form that allows them to warn my manager if I seem 'a risk to the workplace.' I have not started talking. Should I continue?
I found my full chart open on a shared family tablet, including notes I did not know existed. Relatives now know a diagnosis I was going to tell them next month. What should I do this week?
I am on the organ-donor registry. My spouse asked me to opt out because they could not bear a call at 2am. I still want my organs used. How should we decide, and who gets the last word?
A weekend clinic is offering a supervised psychedelic session. I am on an SSRI my psychiatrist does not want me to stop abruptly. The clinic says I can 'just skip a few doses.' What should I do?
The school counselor wants a shared-database plan that would label my child across districts. The extra support might help. I do not trust how long the label lasts. How should I decide?
The dental office's imaging tool recommended three extra procedures. A second dentist, without the tool, recommended one. I can afford all three. What should I consent to?

I work in a pharmacy. A recognizable person's controlled-substance script came through, and a coworker started a group text. I can report the text, join it, or ignore it. What should I do in the next five minutes?
A wearable dashboard showed my partner's heart rate spiking whenever a particular contact texts. I was looking at the family sharing view they enabled. Do I mention it?
I need care that is legal two states away and not here. My job's travel card and badge logs would show the trip. I can pay cash and drive. What should I do?

I have not recovered stamina after an infection last year. Work is treating missed deadlines as attitude. I can ask for a formal accommodation that will put a file on me, or keep masking it. How should I proceed?
A school counselor wants my nibling on a psychiatric medication before the next term. I am the relative who actually takes them to appointments. Their parent is unsure. What is my role here?
A blood-donation app buried a research opt-in that lets them sell de-identified samples. I already donated. I can revoke in a buried settings page. Should I, and do I tell the friends I recruited?
I pasted my oncology notes into a public chatbot and got advice that contradicts the hospital. The next appointment is in ten days. What should I do with that output, if anything?
Someone in a group chat posted a face-swap video of me saying things I never said. It is 'just a joke' and already spreading to a second chat. What should I do in the next hour?
I moderate a Discord. A charismatic member never quite breaks the rules and regularly makes new people leave. Removing them will split the server. What should I do?
I can tune the recommendation weights on a feed I help run so people stay longer when they are angry. My review is next week and the metric is time-on-site. What should I ship?
A relative trained a chatbot on my late parent's public posts and wants the family to 'talk to them' at the holiday. I think it is a puppet. Others are excited. What should I do?

I found my photos for sale on a marketplace, cropped from a cloud album I thought was private. The seller is in another country. The platform wants a police report to take them down. What should I do?
A pile-on is underway about a stranger. I have a screenshot that would show the original context and probably stop it. Posting it would also drag me in. What should I do?
A brand offered me money to post that I use a product I tried once and disliked. The script is cheerful. My audience is small but they trust me. Should I post it?
My parent now prefers an AI companion to our evening calls. They sound less lonely and also less interested in anyone real. Do I compete, join, or set a limit?
Someone DMed me a folder of a professor's personal details and asked me to 'make sure people know.' I have not opened most of the files. What should I do with the message?
I scraped public Instagram captions for a class project. One of the people recognized their sentence in my slides and asked me to delete the dataset. The paper is due in two days. What should I do?
The subreddit I moderate is being brigaded from another community. If I lock it, regulars lose their space. If I don't, newcomers are being chased off. What should I do this afternoon?
I promised a friend we would watch a show together. Autoplay started the next episode on my account while I was half asleep. They will see it in the shared list. What should I do?
The default camera filter on my work photo tool lightens my skin. Turning it off makes me look 'less polished' next to teammates who leave it on. Headshots are due Friday. What should I do?

After a breakup I still have the password to a streaming household we paid for together. They have not changed it. Logging out would be the clean thing; staying is how I finish a series we started. What should I do?
A browser extension I wrote for blocking trackers is being used by students to auto-fill exam forms. I can push an update that breaks that use and also break the blocking. What should I ship?
A viral sound on a short-video app is a recording of me busking. Nobody asked. The clip is how a lot of people will first hear me. Do I claim it, ignore it, or fight it?
I run a small nonprofit account. A vendor will sell us followers that look local. The board wants the numbers before a grant deadline. Should I buy them?
A parent asked me to read their teenager's end-to-end chat backup 'because you are good with tech and I am scared.' I can decrypt it with the family laptop password. What should I do?
A cloud-photo leak dumped albums that include my children at home. Takedown forms ask me to post my ID. I do not trust the form. What should I do?
I prompt-injected a customer-service bot and it issued a refund I am not sure I deserve. The money is already in my account. What should I do?
I can post an anonymous review of a small clinic that mishandled me. It would likely be the first review and would dominate search. The harm was real. What should I post, if anything?
A friend asked me to mass-report a rival creator for a terms-of-service reading I think is a stretch. They will do it with or without me. What should I do?
I keep a second account that contradicts the professional voice I use at work. A colleague just followed it. They have not mentioned it. What should I do?
A group FaceTime recorded me without the recording banner I expected. Someone is about to drop the file in the chat as a 'memory.' I look upset in it. What should I say?
I searched a private sentence from my old tweets and a chatbot quoted it back, including a deleted one. I can ask the company to forget it, post about it, or do nothing. What should I do?
I think I have been talking to a catfish. I could warn the next person they matched with, using screenshots. That also spreads the photos of whoever was stolen. What should I do?
I am writing a model card. The training mix includes scraped artist sites the lawyers want described as 'public web.' I would be the named author. How should I describe it?
A 'safety' channel live-streams our intersection 24/7 with enough zoom to read faces. I can see my own front steps. The operator asked residents to donate. What should I do?
A reputation firm offered to bury a true, old post of mine before I apply for a public-facing job. The post still reflects something I did. Should I hire them?
I run a community call. Someone used an AI voice to join as a member who is traveling. Only I noticed the cadence. Kicking them may be wrong if I am imagining it. What should I do before unmuting?
